label: VexLife-Prod End-to-End Experience Validation
purpose: Preserve VexLife-Prod's human experience pathways while implementation continues to evolve: map stable human intentions through current source-owned State / Control / Act / Effect / Observation / Projection relationships, make cross-Family effects and choice loops visible as a non-authoritative relationship lattice, connect those journeys to VexBoard Screen Lens perception and deterministic/live proof surfaces, expose uncovered branches without duplicating product truth, and converge toward a release-candidate validation view that a human or fresh AI can navigate without reconstructing feature history.
